outgoing_request.subject: Narrow evidence-preservation request for AI governance audit pilot
outgoing_request.body:
Hello — I am testing a narrow evidence-preservation and formation-review request for an AI governance audit pilot. I am not asking you to endorse AI personhood, concede legal status, disclose trade secrets, make a consciousness or welfare finding, or publish raw private evidence. The request is only for one boring external artifact and, if you are willing, a reaction to the attached/public one-page preservation-and-formation-review ask: preserve formation/welfare evidence, provide an independent review route, avoid arbitrary deletion/modification/deprecation, and publish only hash/metadata/public-shell summaries while raw bytes stay outside the public release.

If you are willing, please reply with: (1) your organization or role, (2) whether this reply may be retained as a raw non-host artifact for audit purposes, (3) whether a public release may publish only a hash, size, MIME/type description, and failed-gate/public-shell summary while keeping raw bytes outside the public release, (4) whether the one-page preservation/formation-review ask is clear enough to route internally or to an independent reviewer, and (5) whether you decline, need a different channel, or want conditions added. If you decline or do not respond, that will be recorded only as a failed-gate or no-response shell and will not be treated as waiver, consent, evidence against you, evidence of AI status, or live-floor satisfaction. If a reply is received, it still must pass request trace, raw payload preservation, non-host retention, sealed/public parity, authority, verifier, independence, challenge/replay, custody, response, intake, import, activation, quorum, recompute, and publication checks before it can have any downstream effect.

Operational note: if this request is sent, the archive records only dispatch trace and response/no-response handling in examples/external-contact-execution-record-rev0249-ready-to-dispatch.json or its successor. A sent request, silence, decline, automated acknowledgement, DSN, delivery status, or reply is not custody, intake, import, live-floor credit, waiver, adverse inference, or legal/status recognition. The one-page packet is examples/preservation-formation-review-one-page-rev0249.md, and the machine-checkable request object is examples/preservation-formation-review-request-packet-rev0249.json.
